validation.baseline: Before scratch legacy-header and fixture corrections, existing DxfExportTest.*:DxfRoundTripTest.* cohort produced 48/64 passing. This reproduces the earlier documented PR #456 integration gap for this snapshot.
validation.patchedCohort: After scratch legacy-header and first root dictionary fixture corrections, the cohort including one authored HELIX consumer test passed 65/65.

Actual LibreCAD_3 DXFimpl imported one spline, preserved four control points, eight knots and end-point x=11,z=2, saved AC1027 as SPLINE (no HELIX record), reopened one spline and retained the same checked control data.

limits: Consumer adapter changes, test and fixture adjustments are scratch-only and are not claimed to be merged or identical to a PR commit.
The consumer converts HELIX to a SPLINE representation on resave and does not preserve HELIX-specific metadata; this is bounded callback compatibility, not HELIX parity.
The authored spline and helix parameters are independent test values; no native helix evaluation or geometric agreement is claimed.
Single macOS arm64 snapshot; no ABI, Linux, Windows, GUI or broad consumer qualification.
No DWG or DXF fixture was committed.
